APIs.name: mgf
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
def mgf (X : Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  μ[fun ω => exp (t * X ω)]

APIs.name: cgf
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
def cgf (X : Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) (t : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  log (mgf X μ t)

APIs.name: mgf_pos
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
theorem mgf_pos [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (h_int_X : Integrable (fun ω => exp (t * X ω)) μ) :
    0 < mgf X μ t

APIs.name: integrableExpSet
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
def integrableExpSet (X : Ω → ℝ) (μ : Measure Ω) : Set ℝ :=
  {t | Integrable (fun ω ↦ exp (t * X ω)) μ}

APIs.name: hasDerivAt_integral_pow_mul_exp_real
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
lemma hasDerivAt_integral_pow_mul_exp_real (ht : t ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) (n : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ μ[fun ω ↦ X ω ^ n * exp (t * X ω)])
      μ[fun ω ↦ X ω ^ (n + 1) * exp (t * X ω)] t

APIs.name: deriv_cgf
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
lemma deriv_cgf (h : v ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) :
    deriv (cgf X μ) v = μ[fun ω ↦ X ω * exp (v * X ω)] / mgf X μ v

APIs.name: iteratedDeriv_two_cgf
APIs.complete_API_or_definition_value:
lemma iteratedDeriv_two_cgf (h : v ∈ interior (integrableExpSet X μ)) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 (cgf X μ) v
      = μ[fun ω ↦ (X ω) ^ 2 * exp (v * X ω)] / mgf X μ v - deriv (cgf X μ) v ^ 2
